title: From The Start
lyrics:
[00:05.12]Don't you notice how
[00:08.56]I get quiet when there's no one else around?
[00:14.50]Me and you and awkward silence
[00:17.50]Don't you dare look at me that way
[00:23.20]I don't need reminders of how you don't feel the same
[00:28.56]Oh, the burning pain
[00:32.03]Listening to you harp on 'bout some new soulmate
[00:37.86]She's so perfect
[00:39.30]Blah, blah, blah
[00:40.44]Oh, how I wish you'll wake up one day
[00:46.67]Run to me confess your love
[00:49.28]At least just let me say
[00:52.00]That when I talk to you
[00:55.28]Oh, cupid walks right through
[00:58.22]And shoots an arrow through my heart
[01:04.05]And I sound like a loon
[01:07.01]But don't you feel it, too?
[01:09.92]Confess I loved you from the start
[01:38.74]What's a girl to do
[01:42.12]Lying on my bed staring
[01:44.88]Into the blue?
[01:48.10]Unrequited terrifying
[01:51.19]Love is driving me a bit insane
[01:56.88]Have to get this off my chest
[01:59.52]I'm telling you today
[02:02.19]That when I talk to you
[02:05.51]Oh, cupid walks right through
[02:08.40]And shoots an arrow through my heart
[02:14.28]And I sound like a loon
[02:17.25]But don't you feel it, too?
[02:20.14]Confess I loved you from the start
[02:25.99]Confess I loved you
[02:28.87]Just thinking of you
[02:33.19]I know I've loved you from the start
